issues.description: REST endpoint path inconsistency for listing all persons: the template repository exposes GET /persons via PersonResource#getAllPersons (@GetMapping("persons")), but the solution repository changes the mapping to GET /people (@GetMapping("people")). This contradicts the REST API implied by the starter code and will confuse students and break any clients/tests expecting /persons to return the full list.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution repository, change the mapping back to @GetMapping("persons"). If backward compatibility is desired, add an additional alias method or mapping so both /persons and /people are supported, but keep /persons as specified by the template.
